label: Reachability control conjoined with two trivial negations of False
meaning: Trivial conjunction, not an independence result: reachVaryingControl together with two copies of NOT False (the constantly false predicate on Nat applied to the Nat anchor). No composition, intellect or route predicate occurs in the type, so it certifies nothing about composition or intellect. The genuine control is 'A shared reachability profile fixes neither route composition nor intellect' (routeIndependenceControl).
